structured_output.title: ACME profile selection: no ACME Issuer usage visible in environment
structured_output.content: The release note (ev-50f787991f0d) describes a new ability to select ACME certificate profiles, such as Let's Encrypt's `tlsserver` and `shortlived`. The excerpt does not say that anything changes for existing configurations. The environment shows cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD and the values key global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, but no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests or CRDs. Because of that, it can't be confirmed whether any ACME issuer is in use. To decide whether this change matters, check whether your issuers use ACME (for example, Let's Encrypt), and read the full release-note section to see if profile selection changes any default behaviour.
